votes.title: Unlawful Racing and Street Takeovers — Prohibited
votes.summary: Would prohibit participating in unlawful street racing and vehicle 'takeovers' on county roads and establish penalties.

votes.title: Community Trust in County Employees Act
votes.summary: Would restrict the County from hiring people employed after 2025 by the federal government to enforce immigration laws.

votes.title: Bond Authorization — Stormwater Management
votes.summary: Would authorize up to $125 million in bonds for stormwater management projects, backed by the county's Water Quality Protection Charge.
